description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - sky watch: register the drying area before going out, timed reminders to look back at the sky, camera metering grades brightness and a big drop triggers one TTS cloud warning, look-back marked by SKY with a mark (looked / take in / leave), session summary at the end; no weather forecast, brightness drop is only a proxy for thicker cloud, photos are discarded after the reading, session memory only.
name: sky-watch
